title: How to deploy programmable global front ends for internet-facing apps and content
description: Learn to design and deploy the Google Cloud global front end to protect, scale, and deliver web experiences from infrastructure running on-cloud or on-premise. Get an overview of the global front end with load balancing, CDN, and web protection including DDoS mitigation. Then move into programmability with service extension callouts and designing for scenarios across clouds and on-premise. We will cover integration into continuous integration/development workflows, show a demo, and learn from a customer about their use case and lessons learned.
